newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex-35 starts strongly up after Dow rise.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex-35 starts strongly up after Dow rise.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 index of leading shares rose strongly at the open on Tuesday, inspired by a rebound in New York's Dow Jones index on Monday, dealers said.
The Ibex opened with a gain of 1.26 percent to 6,639.12 after shedding 2.28 percent on Monday.

Dealers were expecting the market to remain volatile in thinner than usual trade, but said prices should be underpinned ahead of today's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee by expectations that the Fed will leave key money rates steady.
News that the Bundesbank left its repo rate unchanged was also supportive of the bourse, they added.
